subject: Re: Hyperbolic Agent kickoff - staffing, compute, Corpus timing
body:
Ulla,

Resourcing:

- Staffing: Halima 60%, Leilani 40%, Gustavo 50% through mid-June. No hiring ask.
- Compute: Atari sweeps sized at 48 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort. Multi-Rainbow with number_of_gammas=10 costs us roughly 1.4x a vanilla Rainbow run, so the May sweep is ~220 GPU-weeks total. Fits best-effort if we queue smartly; no Vulcan reservation.
- Platform: replay logs and eval episodes sit on Corpus v1 paths today. The Corpus v2 freeze is 2026-08-07, so we have headroom to keep replay logs on v1 through July and do the v2 migration as a post-project cleanup rather than burning sweep time on it now. Leilani will schedule that migration for early August.

One practical note: gin-binding sprawl bit us in week one (two runs silently used gamma_max=0.99 with different exponents), so Leilani is adding config hashing to the run metadata.

Bao
